=={{header|Omegese}}==
{{works with|omc|sha256 2c824805, aien-dev/omega-mv e5b32567, Linux AArch64}}
Omega has no imports, so the small output helpers (<code>emit</code> and friends) are part of the program.
<syntaxhighlight lang="text">
om2
text nl "\n"
text sp " "
note ds n is the sum of the proper divisors of n, for n below 20000
global ds ulong 20000
note emit writes every byte of a to stdout; a short write is retried, an error exits 1
fn emit a view uchar * to void
o = ulong 0
while lt o len a bound 4096
k = write 1 a o sub len a o
if le k 0
exit 1
end
o = add o ulong k
end
end
note emitu writes n in decimal; 20 digits hold every ulong
fn emitu n ulong to void
d = new uchar 20 0
i = ulong 20
v = n
while true bound 20
i = sub i 1
put d i uchar add rem v 10 48
v = div v 10
if eq v 0
break
end
end
emit part d i sub 20 i
end
note each i adds itself to its multiples 2i, 3i, ... below 20000; fewer than 20000 multiples per i
fn sieve to void
i = ulong 1
while lt i 10000 bound 10000
j = mul i 2
while lt j 20000 bound 20000
put ds j add get ds j i
j = add j i
end
i = add i 1
end
end
fn main to int
sieve
for n ulong 20000
m = get ds n
if and gt m n lt m 20000
if eq get ds m n
emitu n
emit sp
emitu m
emit nl
end
end
end
ret 0
end
</syntaxhighlight>
